//: How level 6 is generated. Run it with: powershell -File tools/rebuild_level.ps1 -Level level_6
notes: gen_skyport.gd owns this level end to end. 'scaffold' REWRITES the .tscn from nothing,
so 'props' is not optional after it -- a scaffold run left alone ships an empty level.
The import between them is load bearing: 'props' instances real nodes (a GridMap needs
its MeshLibrary, KitPiece prefabs need loading) into the scene 'scaffold' just wrote.
'probe' runs AFTER the bake and only reports: it flies DroneSensors.sweep_sky against the
baked level's real collision. It writes nothing, and its numbers deliberately disagree
with scaffold's analytic ladder (see the tool header).
No scatter here on purpose, so there is no ground-hash stage and no resnap.

steps.why: Writes the island heightmap and splat, the three curves, the wind field, the LevelInfo and the level .tscn text, and prints the analytic sats ladder.
Opens the scaffolded scene, hangs the GridMap decks and the kit pieces off its AuthoringRoot, and saves.
Read-only acceptance report against the BAKED level. Needs the bake above.
